all_features:
def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Count of unique words in the text"
    unique_words = set(text.split())
    return float(len(unique_words))

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Average sentence length in words"
    sentences = re.split(r'[.!?]+', text)
    lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences if s.split()]
    return float(sum(lengths) / len(lengths)) if lengths else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Count of punctuation characters divided by total length"
    punctuation_count = sum(1 for c in text if c in string.punctuation)
    return float(punctuation_count) / len(text) if len(text) > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Ratio of uppercase letters to total letters"
    upper_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
    total_letters = sum(1 for c in text if c.isalpha())
    return float(upper_count) / total_letters if total_letters > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Count of words that are more than 6 letters long"
    long_word_count = sum(1 for word in text.split() if len(word) > 6)
    return float(long_word_count)

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Proportion of stopwords in the text"
    doc = nlp(text)
    stopword_count = sum(1 for token in doc if token.is_stop)
    total_count = len(doc)
    return float(stopword_count) / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Average syllables per word in the text"
    syllable_count = sum(textstat.syllable_count(word) for word in text.split())
    total_words = len(text.split())
    return float(syllable_count) / total_words if total_words > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Density of named entities in the text"
    doc = nlp(text)
    entity_count = len(doc.ents)
    total_count = len(doc)
    return float(entity_count) / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:

    unique_word_count = len(set(words))
    return float(unique_word_count) / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0.0

def feature(text: str) -> float:
    "Frequency of the most common word"
    words = text.split()
    if not words:
        return 0.0
    most_common = Counter(words).most_common(1)[0][1]
    return float(most_common) / len(words)
